更新内容
• 新增音频文件关联：可将本应用设为系统默认播放器或在「打开方式」中选择，从资源管理器双击音频文件即可直接播放
• 双击打开的本地音乐文件自动加入音乐库（「外部导入」文件夹）并按文件夹语义播放（同文件夹曲目进入播放队列）；U 盘等可移动设备保持一次性播放，不写入曲库与播放统计
• 外部文件播放支持完整歌词链路：文件旁歌词、内嵌歌词与在线搜索全覆盖，搜索结果独立缓存，重复打开免再联网
• 修复双击导入后歌曲/专辑/艺术家列表与播放队列不刷新、快速连续打开外部文件时迟到歌词覆盖当前曲目的问题
• 启动提速：移除全屏加载过渡，主界面即刻显示；音频引擎、曲库加载与文件扫描并行；扫描无变化时不再重复刷新列表，消除启动闪动
• 标题栏新增全局进度指示：连接引擎、扫描曲库、传输文件等任务统一显示进度，多任务并发时并列展示，任何页面均可见
• 播放页动画文字重构：标题与专辑/艺术家信息合并为单一动画文本整组联动；修复逐字重排像素偏移、跨字体切换动画中断、初始化消失与偶发崩溃
• 新增动画文本悬停滚动选项，鼠标移入时滚动显示完整歌名、专辑与艺术家；新安装默认启用逐字歌词特效，实验性 Win2D 封面选项移除
• Atmos HDMI 直通新增自动独占切换：可指定直通专用设备，失败自动回退同设备 PCM 并发送系统通知；5.1 多声道输出同样支持自动独占；设置页新增 Atmos/5.1 实际输出状态与恢复普通播放入口
• 播放队列改进：同一首歌多次加入队列时保持独立位置，上一首/下一首与双击定位准确；随机播放顺序与当前进度重启后保留
• 退出更迅速干净：退出时取消在途歌词搜索与网络请求，不再等待网络超时；统一收尾后台任务，减少卡顿与残留
• 修复桌面歌词经托盘/快捷键开关后与设置页状态不同步的问题
• 新增崩溃诊断：崩溃与异常通过 Windows 错误报告附带托管堆栈和日志，帮助快速定位问题
• 更新提示补充不兼容软件说明：FPS 监控（RTSS 等）与 Windhawk、StartAllBack 等注入式系统美化软件可能与桌面歌词、着色器背景冲突导致崩溃
• 修复文件标签被外部工具修改后启动扫描不刷新界面的问题；歌词解析迁移到更轻量 JSON 组件，多项服务架构重构提升整体稳定性
en:
Release Notes
• New audio file association: set the app as the system default player or pick it from "Open with" and play audio files directly from File Explorer
• Local music files opened by double-click are added to the library (in an "External Imports" folder) and played with folder semantics (same-folder tracks join the queue); removable drives keep one-shot playback without touching the library or play statistics
• Full lyrics pipeline for external files: sidecar lyrics, embedded lyrics, and online search are all covered, with a dedicated cache so reopening skips the network
• Fixed song/album/artist lists and the play queue not refreshing after a double-click import, and late lyrics from a previous external file overwriting the current track when switching quickly
• Faster startup: the full-screen loading transition is gone and the main UI appears instantly; the audio engine, library loading, and file scanning run in parallel; scans without changes no longer refresh lists, eliminating startup flicker
• New global progress indicator in the title bar: engine connection, library scanning, and file transfers show their progress side by side during concurrent operations, visible on every page
• Reworked animated text on the now-playing page: the title and album/artist lines merge into one animated text block that transitions as a group; fixed per-character re-layout pixel offsets, animation interruptions across font switches, controls vanishing during initialization, and occasional crashes
• New hover-scroll option for animated text that scrolls the full title, album, and artist on mouse-over; word-by-word lyrics effects are on by default for new installs, and the experimental Win2D cover option has been removed
• Atmos HDMI passthrough gains automatic exclusive-mode switching: assign a dedicated passthrough device, with automatic fallback to PCM on the same device plus a system notification on failure; 5.1 multichannel output also supports automatic exclusive mode; the settings page adds live Atmos/5.1 output status and an entry point back to normal playback
• Play queue: repeated additions of the same song keep their own positions, so previous/next and double-click targeting stay accurate; shuffle order and the current position survive restarts
• Faster and cleaner exit: in-flight lyric searches and network requests are cancelled instead of waiting out network timeouts; background tasks are awaited uniformly, reducing hangs and leftovers
• Fixed desktop lyrics toggled from the tray or hotkeys going out of sync with the settings page
• Added crash diagnostics: crashes and exceptions attach managed stacks and logs through Windows Error Reporting for faster diagnosis
• The update notice now covers incompatible software: FPS monitors (RTSS etc.) and injection-based customization tools such as Windhawk or StartAllBack may conflict with desktop lyrics and shader backgrounds and cause crashes
• Fixed startup scans not refreshing the UI after file tags were edited by external tools; the lyrics parser moved to a lighter JSON stack, and service-layer refactorings improve overall stability
